SUBJECT: BOUNDS

URGENT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGIST.
No. CR/4196/G 12/4/30.
Date. 30. 4. 30.）

O.C.R.E. , Shanghai
O.C., Area Signal Section,
2nd Bn The Green Howards
1st Bn The Worcestershire Regiment,
R.A.S.C., Shanghai Area,
No. 7 Gen. Hospital,
Detachment, R.A.O.C.,
D.A.P.M.,
"G" (I).

O.C. R.E.P.S.
Det., R.A.P.C.
12 (MT) Coy.,
Supply Depot

Copy to S.N.O.
Naval Int.Offr.,
(for information)

With effect from today, no troops other than those on
duty will be allowed East of THIBET ROAD between the hours of
12 midnight and 12 noon daily until further orders.

2. Troops quartered in the Area East of THIBET ROAD will be
confined to barracks during these hours.

3. The number of personnel detailed for duty in the
restricted area will be reduced to a minimum.

4. Troops walking out after 12 noon will move in parties of
not less than two.

Shanghai,
26th April, 1930
JMC

H. Rice Williams
Major,
Brigade Major, Shanghai Area.

皇家陆军军械 Corps 分遣队，
助理副军需总监，

皇家工兵邮政服务指挥官
皇家陆军邮务 Corps 分遣队
第12（摩托化）连，
供应仓库

抄送海军高级军官
海军情报官，
（供知悉）

自即日起，除执勤人员外，每日午夜12时至中午12时之间，未经进一步命令，不得进入西藏路以东区域。

2. 驻扎在西藏路以东地区的部队，在上述时间内须禁足于营房内。

3. 派往限制区域执勤的人员数量将减至最低限度。

4. 中午12时后外出的士兵，须两人或以上结伴同行。

上海，
1930年4月26日
JMC

H. Rice Williams
少校，
上海地区旅参谋长。
